verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's docs say every product is classified into a category and subcategory that together determine how it is taxed across jurisdictions. The tax estimate endpoint applies that product taxability alongside nexus, exemptions and ship-to address. That covers the core of per-line-item, per-jurisdiction taxability. missing for 10: an explicit list of categories confirming SaaS, digital goods, services and physical products; documentation of the developer workflow or API for assigning categories to catalog items; independent or hands-on corroboration.
